title: Check: Reactions of Acids with Carbonates (2)

questions.stem: What would you observe when dilute hydrochloric acid is added to green copper carbonate?

options.text: The solution turns green and no gas is produced
Fizzing occurs, the green solid dissolves, and the solution turns blue

questions.explanation: When HCl is added to green copper carbonate, you observe fizzing (CO₂ gas released), the green solid dissolves, and the solution turns blue as copper chloride forms. CuCO₃ + 2HCl → CuCl₂ + H₂O + CO₂.
